grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing your Motability application

grants.description: Share your PIP Enhanced Rate mobility component award details with Motability
grants.purpose: Motability needs to verify your PIP Enhanced Rate mobility component to process your lease application. Your allowance will be paid directly to Motability for the duration of the lease.

grants.description: Confirm the delivery address for your leased vehicle
grants.purpose: To arrange delivery of your selected vehicle to your preferred location

grants.description: Provide details of any additional named drivers who will use the vehicle
grants.purpose: To add authorized drivers to your Motability insurance policy. Up to two named drivers can be added at no extra cost.

grants.description: Provide bank details if making an advance payment for your chosen vehicle
grants.purpose: To process any advance payment you choose to make towards a higher-specification vehicle

revocation.mechanism: Contact Motability directly or through your GOV.UK account to revoke consent and cancel your application
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before lease commencement. If lease is active, standard cancellation terms apply and you will need to contact Motability to end the agreement.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make advance payments on your behalf. Agent cannot add named drivers without your explicit approval. Agent cannot sign the final lease agreement - you must review and sign this yourself. Agent cannot select vehicle adaptations without specific medical assessment confirmation.
